profile.headline: Software Developer | #NextJS #NodeJS #SQL #Typescript
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack software engineer with 7+ years of experience building web platforms, backend systems, and internal tools across government, startups, and freelance environments. I’ve led and contributed to projects ranging from public service platforms at Miami-Dade County to in-game e-commerce systems and healthcare infrastructure in Latin America and Spain.

My core stack includes React, Next.js, NestJS, Spring Boot, Java, and Docker, with strong DevOps experience using CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure, and AWS tools. I’ve built scalable architectures, implemented microservices, integrated Web3 features, and handled infrastructure from scratch in both remote and in-office settings.

What drives me is creating solutions that are impactful, scalable, and user-centered, where I can grow as a product-focused engineer, contribute to meaningful software, and keep learning every day.

Let’s connect — I love chatting about new ideas, dev workflows, and creative software design.
